title: A synthetic permission review classification
method: Fictional 24-action role: 14 ordinary operations, 4 justified recovery actions, and 6 removed after review. Retaining 18 gives a 25% action-count reduction; action count is not a security-risk score. Absence of observed use alone is not evidence for removal.
alt: A synthetic permission review classification. Illustrative values: Ordinary operation 14 actions, Tested recovery 4 actions, Remove after review 6 actions.
